full_ledger_duplicate_audit.Families_B_E: Exposure-state or recovery routing of existing signals. The new protocol has no B02/F05 parent signal.
full_ledger_duplicate_audit.Families_C_D_G_H: Fixed/checkpoint/invalidation exits after existing M15 entries. The new termination is the first completed H1/H4 state reversal and has no fixed checkpoint grid.
full_ledger_duplicate_audit.HYP_001_to_006_and_Families_A_F_I: Admission, shock, extension, acceptance and confirmation filters applied to existing M15/B02/F05 signals. The new protocol constructs the primary signal on completed H4 bars.
full_ledger_duplicate_audit.R1_EMA_trend_cross: EMA crossover was generated on M15 and paired with fixed-time exits. Reusing EMA mathematics on native H4/H1 is allowed only because information time, parent signal and termination are all different; no M15 cell is reopened.
full_ledger_duplicate_audit.RQ_019: Local B02 20-40 pip band partition. No overlap.
full_ledger_duplicate_audit.RQ_020A_D: Fixed M15 strategies, static portfolios and static 5d/20d state overlays. The new state is native H4/H1 primary construction, not an overlay.
full_ledger_duplicate_audit.RQ_020E: Exhausted 60 M15 entry definitions x 11 fixed horizons. The new protocol has no R1 entry and no R2 fixed horizon.
full_ledger_duplicate_audit.old_higher_timeframe_trend_continuation: Used an M15 pullback/resumption trigger with an 8h/12h M15 lookback and fixed six-M15-bar hold; it did not aggregate native H1/H4 bars or event-terminate on higher-timeframe state reversal.
full_ledger_duplicate_audit.scientifically_distinct_information: Both the primary transition and its termination are determined from completed exact-slot native higher-timeframe bars. M15 is execution-only.

literature_decision.parameter_interpretation: The finite periods are natural powers-of-two/session-day engineering scales frozen before outcomes, not literature-optimal values.
